Why brand partnerships in music

Coming from sports sponsorship, I've seen how proper commercial backing fuels entire ecosystems. Music deserves that same investment. I love music, and I want to bring brand partnerships into this role so smaller and developing artists get the real financial backing they need to build sustainable careers without compromising their work.

These are the partnerships I admire, examples of how it's being done right in music and culture, and the kind of backing I want to help build for the roster at Young:

  • Tyler, the Creator x FC Barcelona: cross-vertical apparel collaborations with cultural gravity
  • Dr. Martens, Tough As You: community-led narrative building and authentic casting
  • Levi's, Behind Every Original: multi-genre cultural leadership ambassador programmes
  • CUPRA City Garage Manchester: permanent physical spaces for local artist incubation
  • ASICS x Plaster Magazine: product narratives driven by authentic creative practice
  • Seanchoíche x Monzo: intimate grassroots storytelling scaled through brand partnership
  • Red Bull Music Academy: decades of foundational talent development and education
  • CultureLab x Doug Shapiro: culturally relevant brands are valued at almost three times those that aren't
